title: Satisfaction must be applied: adults receive fruit only by true repentance and living faith
source_text: V. Nec tamen, etiam posita Christi satisfactione, electorum ulli peccata remissa dici possunt, nisi fuerit ipsis secundum Dei legem & institutum applicata. Adultis autem usum rationis habentibus non applicatur Christi meritum & satisfactio, id est, fructum ex Christi merito non percipiunt nisi, mediante vera poenitentia, ac fide viva & per dilectionem efficaci.
pass_a_gloss: Nevertheless, even with Christ’s satisfaction posited, the sins of none of the elect can be said to be remitted unless it has been applied to them according to God’s law and institution. But to adults who have the use of reason Christ’s merit and satisfaction is not applied—that is, they do not receive fruit from Christ’s merit—except by the mediation of true repentance and a living faith efficacious through love.
pass_b_english: Satisfaction alone does not equal remitted sins until applied under God’s institution.
For reasoning adults: true repentance plus living, love-working faith mediate the fruit.

choices.english: by the mediation of true repentance
